explanation: Implement only place, starting from the acknowledged retained grasp at frame 234. Do not repeat pickup or open the fingers during transfer. Recover the measured precontact carton extent by explicit checkpoint-value paths, then locate it using just two independently identified, currently visible short-end corners on a measured current top plane. This avoids requiring its occluded perimeter or a tracker. Measure the bowl's inner lip, check opening fit with propagated operational uncertainty, and obtain a fresh local route review. Execute bounded raise, transfer, optional single centering correction, and above-lip lowering leases. Recheck object motion against actual whole-lease hand motion, and validate bowl stationarity after each lease. Release only with fresh lateral and vertical margins; assess actual containment and finger separation afterward. No withdrawal or final stability stage is implemented. Missing evidence, failed margins, stalls, or changed object states produce an explicit incomplete outcome with preserved measurements.
interface: Executable Python main(api), using only supplied np, geo, allowed builtins, and the exact runtime API. Returns a JSON-compatible object containing stage_status, reason, evidence, handoff, and completion_proposed=false. Normal motion uses api.drive; the single authorized release uses api.control. Four local leases have maxima 20, 32, 12, and 20 calls, with the correction optional; release has at most four three-step controls. Slice boundaries do not cause yield. place.geometry stores numerical references, selected historical paths and provenance, measured rim geometry, uncertainty, and current carton anchors. place.progress stores pending phases, actual execution receipts, retention comparisons, and release state. place.effect preserves fresh or partial review measurements. Existing placement progress triggers an audit rather than repeating prior actions. Handoff lists only existing checkpoint keys and includes actual state, reference assumptions, and frames.
jev_protocol:
All physical commands invoke real Jev through control or drive. Exactly seven choice questions are supplied. The x, y, z, rx, ry, and rz instructions explicitly bind their respective state.processed_features.axes.<axis>.goal_relation fields: negative decreases that world coordinate or world rotation-vector component, positive increases it, and hold means within_tolerance. The gripper question binds the objective selector: close preserves retention, open is authorized only in the release phase, and keep preserves the previous command. Answers are dispatched unchanged. Jev receives measured pose residuals from the host and source-framed program features including current carton geometry, bowl center/radius, uncertainty, phase, and fit margin. It is neither an image observer nor a metric calculator.

The program performs numerical fitting using geo.plane and geo.circle_xy, transforms own finger geometry with geo.rotation, and checks independently measured object-anchor motion against actual before/after hand states with geo.attachment_error. Drive receipts describe only their last update, so whole-lease states are saved separately. A reached pose or delivered closure never proves retention or release. Nonconvergence, stalls, command mismatch, or excessive attachment discrepancy stop the local sequence without repeating contact. Lost retention or changed bowl geometry requests replanning.

Measurement membership and errors are checked before geometry. One replacement review can use a different patch or camera; narrow-lip depth can instead use bounded radius-1 samples at identified current boundary pixels. Bowl landmarks can be replaced by three observable inner-lip samples. No patch tracker is required. Historical carton dimensions are accepted only from identified measured rectangle references; current visible end anchors and a measured plane locate that rigid model. Uncertainty includes historical recorded uncertainty where available, fit residuals, and measured two-pixel ray-intersection sensitivity. Spread tests are relative to noise or required circular coverage, not universal object-size gates. These are operational bounds, not calibrated confidence or hidden-clearance certificates.

Translation tolerance is 0.0015 m, rotation tolerance 0.025 rad. Fit requires over 0.0035 m remaining lateral margin after uncertainty; the release-height target reserves uncertainty plus 0.0055 m, and fresh observed vertical clearance must still exceed 0.003 m after uncertainty. Translation limits are 0.009 m for lifting, 0.014 m for transfer, 0.004 m for a single correction, and 0.006 m for lowering. Release holds use 0.002 m. Each lease is finite and checkpoints acknowledged progress. Fresh post-release RGB-D evidence must show the same carton inside the unchanged upright bowl and visibly separated from the fingers. The outer supervisor alone assesses advancement and eventual whole-task completion.
